feed_summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of three cyber attacks targeting organizations in Japan in which artificial intelligence (AI) was a key element, either in the driving seat or to assist a human operator. TrendAI, which analyzed three exposed server environments used by threat actors to conduct the malicious cyber operations, described them as distinct from previously published
title: CyberStrikeAI Uses 44 AI Agents to Automate Hacking Operations Against Japan Targets
